sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.10

Checkout address fixes, new store filter and sort controls, a live cost estimate when customizing a club shipment, and Styling Studio import fixes.

  • The State list at checkout no longer marks every state as "Not available." On some wineries every state was flagged even though shipping was fine. Now only states the winery truly cannot ship to are marked, and those can no longer be picked by mistake. The billing address form no longer applies shipping restrictions at all.
  • Editing a saved address at checkout works right away. The Save button used to stay greyed out until you clicked through every field. It is now enabled as soon as the form is valid.
  • The store filter bar now has separate search, filter, and sort controls, and you can turn each one on or off in the Styling Studio. You can also choose which order the product grid loads in. Please note: sites with the filter bar on that never chose a sort will now load in your Bottle360 product order instead of Name A to Z.
  • Clearing the store search box no longer makes the products disappear. Clicking the X in the search field used to blank the whole product grid until the page was reloaded.
  • Customizing a club shipment shows the right cost as you switch between Pickup and Delivery. Choosing Pickup now shows Shipping as Free and lowers the total right away, instead of only after you submit and sign back in.
  • Importing a theme file in the Styling Studio is safer. A file missing a section no longer blanks the editor, and settings the file does not mention (like your checkout logo or motion choices) are kept instead of reset.
